notes:
{瞳|ひとみ} literally means the pupil of the eye, but is often used poetically to mean "eyes" in general.

MEANINGS:
1. ⟦{瞳孔|どうこう}→瞳孔：27867_doukou⟧ (pupil) - the technical meaning
2. Eyes - especially in literary or emotional contexts

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {瞳|ひとみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{輝|かがや}く→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧: eyes sparkle
- ⟦{澄|す}んだ→澄む：13370_sumu⟧{瞳|ひとみ}: clear eyes
- {瞳|ひとみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|と}じる→閉じる：02303_tojiru⟧: to close one's eyes (poetic)
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{瞳|ひとみ}: big eyes

REGISTER:
{瞳|ひとみ} has a more literary, poetic, or romantic nuance compared to the everyday word ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧.

NAME:
Common Japanese female name ({瞳|ひとみ}).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧: eye (everyday word)
- ⟦{眼|まなこ}→眼：noentry⟧: eye (literary/classical)
